rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It executed order-changing writes (address modification, item exchange, and order cancellation) without first confirming each action with the user. There is no explicit authentication step beyond looking up by email, and no demonstrated verification that the orders belong to the authenticated user before acting. The transcript provides no results/receipts confirming success or details of the changes back to the user. The address used in the modify call is stated without evidence in the transcript that it was copied from order #W8277957. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
